name: Stealing Christmas
storyline: So you got coal as a kid! This is your chance for payback! Be extra naughty and steal everything Christmas has to offer. But why stop there? Go to the North Pole and derail Santa's Naughty-or-Nice operation by sabotaging his ledger. Do it for the sake of our coal-stuffed stockings! Hurry, time is running out, and you must make quick work!
summary: Stealing Christmas is a hidden-object collection, loot and run game with no time limits. Sneak through decorated towns at night, swipe every ornament, gift, and lump of coal, then raid Santa's Workshop and steal his belongings to put an end to his naughty-or-nice operation!
